newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest shares put on stronger show on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest shares put on stronger show on Thursday.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange recovered its poise on Thursday, with prices drifting higher in better volume as investors looked with renewed interest at lower-priced stocks.
"After the price falls of the last sessions, investors ended their waiting game and started buying," a trader said.
Gainers in average prices led decliners 15 to 11, with one stock remaining unchanged. Some stocks also closed higher, helped by deals made in late trading, brokers said.
Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, jumped by 2.7 and respectively 2.78 percent from the previous session. BIG first-tier index was 3.13 percent at 2,666.88 points.
Active buying pulled volume some 574,000 shares higher to 2.3 million and helped turnover rise by around two billion lei to 6.7 billion.
Traders said they expected the market to extend its recovery on Friday.
The first tier continued to attract strong interest, taking 82 percent of turnover and trading around two million shares.
Two high-caps gained on both average and closing quotes, while the other two first-tier listings lost ground.
Antibiotice ATBE.BX pharmaceuticals company put on 200 lei to close at 4,300 and fertiliser maker Azomures ended 400 lei stronger at 2,500.
Chemical plant Oltchim and Terapia pharmaceuticals shed 150 lei each to end at 2,250 and respectively 5,350.

On the second tier, Policolor PLCR.BX dye maker stayed in demand. It traded more than 187,000 shares on turnover of 912.8 million lei, including a special deal. But it closed 600 lei weaker at 4,500 in heavy supply. The special deal involved 53,823 shares worth a total 242.2 million lei.
Trading on the second tier was otherwise thin, with nine stocks having no deal and two suspended.
